title: Public 200-hour subject outline
supports: Broad training subjects; not a cohort lesson sequence or marking rubric.

title: Public yoga anatomy topic guide
supports: Anatomy topic suggestions, not a cohort syllabus.

title: OpenStax · Anatomical terminology
supports: Directional vocabulary and Figure 1.12, body regions.

title: OpenStax · Types of body movements
supports: Flexion, extension, abduction and adduction.

title: OpenStax · Structure and function of the nervous system
supports: CNS, PNS and the distinction between anatomical and functional divisions; Figure 12.2.

title: Yoga Journal · Warrior II
supports: English and Sanskrit pose names and broad visual identification only; generated art has not been educator-reviewed.

title: Yoga Alliance · Code of Conduct
supports: Principles 6 and 7: inclusion and respect for student–teacher relationships. Used for reflection, not an exhaustive legal or professional guide.

title: YogaEasy · Mountain Pose
supports: Mountain / Tadasana naming and broad pose recognition.

title: YogaEasy · Tree Pose
supports: Tree / Vrksasana naming and broad pose recognition.

title: Art of Living · Chair Pose
supports: Chair / Utkatasana naming and broad pose recognition.

title: YogaEasy · Downward Dog Pose
supports: Downward Dog / Adho Mukha Svanasana naming and broad pose recognition.

title: OpenStax · The process of breathing
supports: Quiet inspiration and expiration: diaphragm, thoracic volume, pressure and elastic recoil.

title: OpenStax · Interactions of skeletal muscles
supports: Agonist, antagonist and synergist roles; biceps/triceps elbow action example.

title: YogaEasy · What is Hatha Yoga?
supports: Modern Hatha class format; the wider meaning of Hatha.

title: YogaEasy · Vinyasa Yoga
supports: Breath-linked movement and variable class sequences.

title: YogaEasy · Ashtanga Yoga
supports: Set series, breath-linked movement and gradual learning.

title: YogaEasy · Yin Yoga
supports: Longer-held, passive, mostly floor-based poses only; no health or tissue claims reproduced.

title: OpenStax · Connective tissue supports and protects
supports: Tendons attaching muscle to bone; connective-tissue types. No treatment or stretching advice used.

title: OpenStax · Synovial joints
supports: Ligaments linking bones and supporting joints; articular cartilage covering joint surfaces; joint cavity.

title: Yoga Journal · Restorative Yoga
supports: Restorative practice uses a small number of supported positions and time for rest; no pose setup, hold time or health benefit is reproduced.

title: Centre for Yoga Studies · Haṭha Pradīpikā, chapter 1
supports: The centre's translation of verses 1 and 17: Haṭha as a ladder toward Rāja Yoga, and āsana introduced first among the text's Haṭha limbs. Historical verse claims are not medical advice.

title: OpenStax · Divisions of the skeletal system
supports: Axial versus appendicular divisions; skull, vertebral column and thoracic cage; sacrum and coccyx are axial.

title: OpenStax · The pectoral girdle
supports: Clavicles and scapulae form the shoulder girdles and belong to the appendicular skeleton.

title: OpenStax · The pelvic girdle and pelvis
supports: Hip bones form the pelvic girdle; distinguish them from the axial sacrum and coccyx.

title: OpenStax · Structure and function of blood vessels
supports: Pulmonary and systemic circulation; right heart to lungs and back; left heart to body and back; arteries carry blood away from the heart and veins return it.

title: Yoga Alliance · RYS 200 standards
supports: RYS 200 common-core categories include teaching environment, pace, cueing, professionalism, feedback and introductory marketing; Yoga Humanities names major texts. A benchmark, not this cohort's lesson plan.

title: Harvard Divinity School · Nonviolence (Ahiṃsā)
supports: Author's translation of Yoga Sūtra II.30 places ahiṃsā among the yamas, with wider historical context. One interpretation, not this cohort's assigned translation.

title: Yoga Alliance · Code of Conduct
supports: A modern teacher-ethics comparison: do no harm, actively include individuals and seek explicit informed consent before physical assistance. Not a cohort-specific policy.

title: NIH NCCIH · Yoga: Effectiveness and Safety
supports: Research suggests some possible benefits but results and practices vary; health conditions can change individual safety needs.

title: Yoga Alliance · Scope of Practice
supports: Modern professional boundary for Yoga Alliance members: teach within training and do not provide unlicensed advice. Not this cohort's exact policy.

title: Yoga Journal · Pose A–Z
supports: English and Sanskrit names and broad pose families for illustrative recognition studies; no instructional sequence or course-specific required list is inferred.

title: Yoga International · Plank naming
supports: Uses Phalakasana as the name for Plank Pose; no practice directions or benefits copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Supine Spinal Twist
supports: Uses Supta Matsyendrasana for Supine Spinal Twist and shows a reclining, bent-knee silhouette; no health claims or instructions copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Camel Pose
supports: Uses Ustrasana for Camel Pose and shows a kneeling backbend silhouette; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Fish Pose
supports: Uses Matsyasana for Fish Pose and shows a reclining backbend with the chest lifted on the forearms; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Locust Pose
supports: Uses Salabhasana for Locust Pose and shows a face-down backbend with the chest and legs lifted; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Boat Pose
supports: Uses Paripurna Navasana for Boat Pose and shows a seated V-shaped balance; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Happy Baby Pose
supports: Uses Ananda Balasana for Happy Baby Pose and shows a reclining shape with knees bent wide and hands holding the feet; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Dolphin Pose
supports: Names Ardha Pincha Mayurasana as another name for Dolphin Pose and shows a forearm-supported inverted-V shape; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · One-Legged King Pigeon Pose
supports: Uses Eka Pada Rajakapotasana for One-Legged King Pigeon Pose and shows the upright pigeon shape with one shin forward and the other leg extended back; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.

title: Yoga Journal · Crow Pose or Crane Pose
supports: Distinguishes Kakasana (Crow, bent arms with knees on the upper arms) from Bakasana (Crane, straighter arms) and notes the two are often practised as variations of each other; no practice directions, benefits or health claims copied.
